title: Combined Therapy With L-Thyroxine and L-Triiodothyronine Compared to L-Thyroxine Alone
brief_summary: The objective of this study was to analyze the features of monotherapy with L-T4 in comparison with combined therapy with L-T4 and L-T3 in patients with primary hypothyroidism.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Premenopausal women with overt primary hypothyroidism (reduced T4 concentration accompanied by increased TSH concentration at the time of initial diagnosis) who did not receive thyroid hormones

Exclusion Criteria:

* Peri- and postmenopause
* Pregnancy
* Major comorbidity
* Use of drugs that affect metabolism or bioavailability of thyroid hormones preparations.
